items.title: Jamey Aebersold interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 26, 2022
items.q: Lillian, Lilly, the girl, saxophone player, she said, “I practiced an hour and a half on Friday.”

ctx.x: You said the next — this upcoming engagement you’re going south for, you made this little aside saying I don’t know how they’re going to bill it. If they bill it as jazz no one will come.

If they bill it as jazz then there’ll probably be twelve or thirteen jazzers there. But the violins won’t come, the oboes, the trumpets that don’t [inaudible] in the orchestra. This jazz thing, Monk, is still really scary to so many people. Oh it’s just — and it’s so silly because I can get them playing in no time at all. I was with somebody the other day who is a professional and his playing doesn’t swing. Okay? But he doesn’t really play swing stuff but there was someone playing with him that I know and he was…
Have you ever tried a classical sounding accompaniment and having people, having students play as if J.S. Bach was improvising?
